deleteBody: The function will be deleted. Its mail addresses will be removed.
title: Functions
emptyHint: Functions are the offices in your club, such as president or treasurer. Create them and assign members.
grantsRoleHint: Whoever holds the function has this role until the function ends.
notFound: This function does not exist (any more).
grantsRolesHint: Whoever holds the function has these roles until the function ends (for example Board and Treasurer).
scopeGroup: One group per person (roles count there only)
pickGroup: Pick a group, then assign a person
perGroupLocked: Remove everyone from the function first, then switch.
perGroupHint: Filled per group (for example Coach). Its roles count only in the person's group.
grantsRolesGroupHint: Whoever holds the function in a group has these roles for that group. Admin roles can't be used here.
